highest_authority: Shun owner-level Human Reality overrides internal technical PASS on visible design quality.

review_dimensions.question: Can the selected research mechanism be recognized in the rendered design without relying on metadata?
Does this feel designed for this company and decision state, rather than like a generic premium skin?
Do hero, body modules, proof, CTA and ending form one intentional page rather than a component collage?
Does typography create hierarchy, tone and confidence appropriate to the mechanism/company?
Does the full-page silhouette visibly differ where the selected mechanisms require it?
Are density and negative space authored as a persuasive arc rather than repeated section padding?
Do media geometry, crop, layering and text relationship advance persuasion instead of merely filling image slots?
Are there memorable composed moments that justify premium design quality?
Would a human reasonably describe this as the same template with swapped images/copy as another sample?
Does mobile preserve/re-author the mechanism instead of simply stacking desktop DOM?
Looking at the whole page as a customer/owner, does the design feel professionally art-directed and commercially credible?

hard_return_conditions: selected benchmark mechanism is not visibly realized
page feels like a shared template despite metadata differences
major modules are individually polished but incoherent as a page
typography/spacing/media framing are generic enough to erase company-specific art direction
desktop passes but mobile loses the selected mechanism
technical QA is green but human whole-page review is materially negative
review_order: Review 1440 and 390 full-page screenshots first without reading implementation metadata.
Record immediate whole-page impression and template resemblance.
Then inspect selected pattern/variant trace and judge mechanism fidelity.
Inspect remaining 9-width evidence for responsive art direction and regressions.
Compare same-Family pair and cross-Family pair to detect shared-renderer smell.
Return explicit scene/variant-level reasons; do not substitute numeric score for judgment.
forbidden_shortcuts: PASS because images are high quality
PASS because CSS class names/variant IDs differ
PASS because all automated tests are green
owner_gate: After Aoi/Sarah PASS, Shun review of actual HTML may still RETURN the design. Such a RETURN reopens the relevant design architecture claim and must not be rationalized away by prior internal PASS.
non_claim: A PASS does not independently prove ¥1M market value; it proves the intended design mechanisms are visibly and coherently realized for the reviewed evidence set.
